Messages.Author: PhantomLord
Messages.Body:
We were playing the other day, I put a Bundi on Hektor, and then went
into combat, used a Torn Signpost pre-range, and made a strike with
Undead Strength. Now, I said that it was a strike for 3+1+2, that's 6
aggravated damage, because Hektor's hand strikes are aggravated and I
used Bundi which clearly says to make a hand strike, but my opponent
said that since I used the weapon, I used only the weapon, and
Hektor's ability doesn't count even though it is a hand strike. I need
a clearance on this one. Once and for all, who was right, my opponent
or me?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
PhantomLord wrote:
> We were playing the other day, I put a Bundi on Hektor, and then went
> into combat, used a Torn Signpost pre-range, and made a strike with
> Undead Strength. Now, I said that it was a strike for 3+1+2, that's 6
> aggravated damage, because Hektor's hand strikes are aggravated and I
> used Bundi which clearly says to make a hand strike

Correct.

>, but my opponent
> said that since I used the weapon, I used only the weapon, and
> Hektor's ability doesn't count even though it is a hand strike.

You used only the weapon.
The strike (made only with the weapon) is a hand strike.
Damage from Hektor's hand strikes (including a hand strike made with Bundi) is
aggravated.


